standard_prerequisites.name: Scheme case: finite type over finite morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the schemes version applied to $\psi$.

core_obligations: Representability and chart: $f$ finite is representable; choose a scheme $V$ surjective \'etale over $Y$; $U = V \times_Y X$ is a scheme surjective \'etale over $X$ and $\psi : U \to V$ is finite (base change of $f$) (proof lines 743-749).
Transport: $\psi_*(\mathcal{F}|_U) = f_*\mathcal{F}|_V$, so finite type of $\mathcal{F}$ over $X$ is equivalent to finite type of $f_*\mathcal{F}$ over $Y$ by the scheme case (proof lines 749-752).
proof_roadmap: Use representability of finite morphisms to get an \'etale chart by schemes.
Push the module identity through the chart and apply the scheme case.
difficulty_reason: The proof sets up the \'etale chart: a finite morphism is representable, so over a surjective \'etale chart $V \to Y$ the base change $U = V \times_Y X$ is a scheme finite over $V$, and the identity $\psi_*(\mathcal{F}|_U) = f_*\mathcal{F}|_V$ transports the question to the scheme case.
